snapshot.title: Time Jump — 10:00 AM

fields.narration: Facilitator: This is 10:00 AM on Saturday, October 24, 2026. The situation has escalated. HUOG-FW01 has isolated the Data VLAN, cutting off all GCS units from the NAS and HUOG-PROC01. GCS-02 is confirmed infected and grounded. The last good backup, OB-1, is from March 20, 2026—three weeks outdated. The Systems & Cybersecurity Lead has confirmed that CP&L and CVAC data was accessed during the unauthorized window. The General Manager must decide within four hours whether to notify clients that D-3 is at risk. The Emergency Response Plan is now active under HUOG-ERP Section 8.5. All roles, review your responsibilities and prepare for formal incident declaration under HUOG-ISP Section 9.3.
